description: Use when Flow is a Platform Event publisher, subscriber, or both. Triggers: 'publish platform event from flow', 'platform-event-triggered flow', 'high-volume platform event', 'publish after commit vs immediate', 'PE subscriber error handling', 'integration fan-out from save'. NOT for Change Data Capture — use integration/change-data-capture-integration. NOT for async work that needs no pub/sub — use flow/scheduled-flows.
inputs: Platform Event object definition (Standard-Volume or High-Volume)
Subscriber list (Flow, Apex, external via Pub/Sub API)
name: flow-platform-events-integration
official_sources: Platform Events Developer Guide (Winter '27, 264) — each platform event–triggered flow interview runs asynchronously in a separate transaction (`platform_events.txt` L2187–2188); synchronous limits apply to platform event triggers (L2338–2339); a flow receives at most 200 event messages per batch (L2185); each interview runs in the publishing user's context while debug logs show Automated Process (L2190–2192); `PlatformEventSubscriberConfig` is Apex-trigger-only (`api_meta.txt` 264 L99118). Apex Developer Guide (264) — heap 10 MB sync / 25 MB async (`salesforce_apex_developer_guide.txt` L19780), a release-level change absent from the API 68.0 versioned list (L45118–45129) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/264/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/platform_events.pdf
